subject: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechcorp.com>, David Lin <david.lin@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

Hi Aisha / David —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery call, attached is the MAP draft with the load/performance test milestone filled out for your review. High level summary of the milestone we discussed:

- Objective: Run a traffic-replay load test to validate peak QPS, latency P95 targets, and to size dedicated capacity for production.
- Target close for milestone: 2026-03-05 (map-level target; final infra signoff may shift).
- Dependencies: access to anonymized traffic replay corpus, agreed peak QPS numbers, test window (off-peak vs peak), and account provisioning for Dedicated GPUs.
- Responsibilities:
  - FinTechCorp: provide replay corpus, confirm peak QPS and acceptable latency targets, coordinate internal stake-holders (platform/ops).
  - Redwood: run the replay on staging and Dedicated candidate pool; produce test report with latency/throughput graphs and recommended capacity sizing.

Action items in the attached MAP and test plan: see milestone row "Load/Performance Test" and the test-plan PDF: planned dates, suggested test profile (90% read, 10% generate), expected replay scale, and owner assignments.

Quick asks for this week so we can book the slot:
1) Can you confirm nominal peak QPS and 95th percentile latency SLOs you care about? (e.g., 2k QPS / P95 < 250ms)
2) Is there an available 4-hour window next week to run traffic replay on a Dedicated pool (we prefer off-peak business hours)?
3) Any compliance gating (IP allowlist, VPN) we should arrange before test?

Attachments: 20260210-MAP-draft.xlsx, 20260210-map-test-plan.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop Aditya and Vivek to handle test orchestration once we have the replay data and time window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

Thanks Marissa — good recap and the MAP looks solid. Quick answers below:

1) Peak QPS: our engineering metrics team reports a recent peak of ~1,800 QPS for the feature surface we want to validate; we'd like to validate to 2,000 QPS to have headroom.
2) Latency SLO: P95 generation latency target is 300ms end-to-end (client->response). If you can show P95 < 250ms that's a win.
3) Test window: next Tue 17 Feb, 02:00–06:00 PT (off-peak) looks available — can you confirm Redwood can run in that window?
4) Compliance/network: we need an IP allowlist and a short NDA addendum — I'll have our security ops send the allowlist; VPN not required.

We'll upload an anonymized replay corpus (last 7 days, redacted) to the secure link by EOD Friday. I'll assign David to coordinate on the replay artifact.

Aisha
Director of Platform Engineering | FinTechCorp
aisha.patel@fintechcorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechcorp.com>, David Lin <david.lin@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

Perfect — thanks Aisha. Confirming next steps and owners:

- FinTechCorp (Aisha/David): upload replay corpus to our secure transfer link by EOD Fri (13 Feb); provide IP allowlist.
- Redwood (Aditya/Vivek): confirm Dedicated capacity profile and run replay in the window Tue 17 Feb 02:00–06:00 PT. We will preserve a staging copy and run two passes: baseline (staging pool) and dedicated-candidate pool.
- Marissa (me): update MAP milestone dates to reflect the 17 Feb test; collect test report and schedule a results review 72 hours after the test.

Aditya / Vivek — can you confirm Dedicated pool sizing recommendation for a 2,000 QPS target and whether we need any special quantization/model variant for cost/latency optimization? Also confirm you can own the orchestration on 17 Feb.

Note: I attached the MAP + test plan again for easy reference.

Thanks all,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechcorp.com>, David Lin <david.lin@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

All — quick internal confirmation and sizing guideline:

- We can run the two-pass replay on Tue 17 Feb 02:00–06:00 PT. Please send the corpus link and IP allowlist as soon as available so we can pre-stage data.
- For a 2,000 QPS target with generation profile ~10% generation, recommended Dedicated pool: 8x A100-80GB (or equivalent) with sharded serving and KV cache enabled. That gives us headroom for bursts and accurate latency curves.
- If FinTechCorp has strict latency SLOs (P95 < 300ms), we'll test both FP16 and a 4-bit quantized variant; the quantized variant may reduce cost but we should validate sample-quality.
- Ownership: Aditya (test orchestration & logs), Vivek (Dedicated pool allocation / infra), Neha (quality/regression checks & report).

We'll prepare a runbook and a monitoring dashboard and share it by Mon EOD (16 Feb). If FinTechCorp prefers a different instance type/region, flag it now.

Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
